source: HaGRID (A. Kapitanov, A. Makhlyarchuk, K. Kvanchiani), 384p sample cj-mills/hagrid-sample-30k-384p, CC BY-SA 4.0. Numbers derived from the images: MediaPipe GestureRecognizer (IMAGE mode) hand landmarks, world landmarks and top-1 canned gesture, on a square crop around the labelled hand (w, h = crop size in px). Tune split only. This file is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0. Tilted rows (group *_tilted): the crop rotated by `angle` degrees (clockwise on screen) and run through the model again.
